text:
Maria: Tritonix sent their perf plan — want to align on the SLO/KPI schema before we hand off the runbook. TL;DR: perf/W and sustained latency targets for 512-token runs on Llama-2-13B, plus kernel variant comparisons.
Tim: Can we lock the telemetry schema today? Need exact metric names for ingestion + marketplace metadata.
Chen: I drafted a minimal schema — keep names stable for ingestion. snippet: ```json
{
  "throughput_tokens_per_sec": "float",
  "power_watts_p95": "float",
  "latency_p99_ms": "float",
  "kv_cache_hit_rate": "float",
  "run_id": "string",
  "kernel_variant": "string"
}
```
Maria: Looks good. add a field for "partner_tag" so partner-side tooling can auto-attach.
Chen: Added. final line now includes "partner_tag": "string". Also recommend we pin the model config: model_name, seq_len, batch_size.
Sophie: Heads-up — Tritonix requested a 7-day embargo on publishing numbers after the run for joint announcement coordination. Legal needs to confirm but please assume embargo for planning.
Alex: Run schedule proposal: dry-run week of Apr 21 (sanity + instrumentation), smoke tests 2 days, main sweep 4 days. Two kernel variants: baseline (-O1) and optimized (-O2 + quant). We'll capture perf/W across power caps.
Tim: Are we good to require p95 power sample window and p99 latency window? Also define the sample frequency (1s) so graphs align.
Chen: Yes — sample_rate=1s, power_aggregation=p95, latency_window=p99. I'll push telemetry mapping to the bench repo.
Tim: @benchbot can you create the ingestion endpoint and a small validation harness?
benchbot: creating endpoint /hooks/partners/tritonix/ingest -> queue:partner-bench. Validation harness: runs a 60s synthetic with known tokens and checks throughput_tokens_per_sec +/- 5%. ETA 3h.
benchbot: Note: tagging must include partner:tritonix and run_id in headers. Any mismatch -> rejected with 422.
Maria: Good. Alex — can you own the runbook + owner list? Chen owns telemetry mapping, Sophie owns NDA/press cadence. I'll shepherd announcement alignment. :thumbsup:
Alex: On it. I'll create a single-runbook doc in the repo with steps, exact commands, and asset upload locations.
Sophie: Legal says embargo is 7 days post-acceptance of results; we'll need a signed addendum in the SOW. I'll start that today.
Maria: Perfect. Next actions: Alex creates runbook by EOD Friday, Chen posts telemetry mapping PR, benchbot confirms endpoint, Sophie gets legal addendum drafted. Anyone object?
Tim: no objections.
Chen: ack, will PR today.
Sophie: ack, will ping legal.
benchbot: endpoint active and smoke validation passed (timestamp 1745257890).
Maria: thanks — moving this to ops channel after runbook is live.
